programme.desc: Naya menyadari bahwa masa-masa sekolah menengahnya tidak seasyik kebanyakan remaja lainnya. programme.title: How To Chip In Golf - New Way vs Old Way

programme.desc: Naya terbangun dan menjerit histeris ketika melihat Jetta sungguhan sedang berbaring di sampingnya, tersenyum manis, dan menyapanya. Naya panik dan berusaha berpikir jernih tentang apa yang terjadi semalam, “Apakah keinginanku semalam benar-benar terkabul?” Sejak saat itu, Jetta selalu muncul dan mengikuti Naya ke mana pun ia pergi, hingga membuat teman-teman sekolahnya mulai curiga.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E3
programme.desc: Naya meminta bantuan Reno untuk menyembunyikan Jetta di rumahnya. Ia juga berdoa kepada Tuhan agar Jetta bisa kembali ke dunianya, karena ia tidak ingin membuat situasi menjadi lebih rumit. Namun, Naya tidak bisa berhenti memikirkan Jetta, hingga akhirnya Jetta muncul di kamarnya. Naya berteriak keras, membuat orang tuanya datang ke kamar. Akankah mereka mengetahui keberadaan Jetta?

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E4
programme.desc: Naya merasa gugup ketika Queena memintanya untuk memperkenalkannya kepada Jetta. Saat Naya sedang memikirkan Jetta, tiba-tiba Jetta muncul dan membuat suasana kantin menjadi ramai. Pada saat yang sama, Majja datang dan meminta Jetta untuk pergi. Hampir terjadi pertengkaran, dan Queena yang marah pun meminta Majja untuk mengakhiri hubungan mereka.

programme.title: I Got Custom Fit For Golf Clubs At The New American Golf Trafford Store

programme.desc: Hari-hari Naya menjadi berbeda sejak kedatangan Jetta. Kini Naya bisa hang out di mal dan menghabiskan waktu bersama Jetta. Di sekolah pun Naya merasa bahagia karena bisa merasakan persahabatan dengan geng perempuannya, Queena. Naya mulai merasakan keseruan masa SMA seperti yang selalu ia harapkan.

programme.title: Can EAL Break 90 At The Scottish Open

programme.title: 5 Simple Ways To Fix Your Golf Hook

programme.title: Satu Hati Untuk Garuda
programme.desc: Satu Hati Untuk Garuda. Program spesial yang menampilkan semangat, dedikasi, dan dukungan tanpa henti bagi Tim Nasional Indonesia. Melalui kisah inspiratif, momen berkesan, serta semangat para pendukung, program ini menggambarkan perjalanan dan ambisi Garuda dalam mengharumkan nama bangsa di pentas internasional.

programme.title: ASEAN C'ship Hyundai Cup 2026
programme.desc: ASEAN C'ship Hyundai Cup 2026 merupakan ajang sepak bola paling bergengsi di Asia Tenggara yang mempertemukan tim nasional terbaik kawasan. Negara-negara unggulan seperti Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia, dan Singapura bersaing bersama tim peserta lainnya dalam format kandang dan tandang. Setiap pertandingan menjadi penentu dalam perebutan gelar juara ASEAN, dengan pertandingan berlangsung di berbagai negara peserta, bukan di satu negara tuan rumah.

programme.title: Sportacular International Match
programme.desc: Sportacular International Match menyajikan pertandingan sepak bola internasional yang mempertemukan tim nasional dari berbagai belahan dunia. Tim-tim unggulan maupun negara yang sedang membangun generasi baru menguji kekuatan skuad, strategi, dan pemain muda mereka melalui laga persahabatan serta pertandingan internasional yang menjadi persiapan penting menuju turnamen besar berikutnya.

programme.title: Konosuba, Ep 5
programme.desc: Kazuma Satou, seorang remaja yang meninggal dalam kecelakaan yang memalukan, bertemu dengan Dewi Aqua di alam setelah kematian. Ia diberi kesempatan untuk bereinkarnasi ke dunia fantasi dan memilih satu benda untuk dibawa. Setibanya di dunia baru, keduanya segera menyadari bahwa kehidupan sebagai petualang tidak semudah yang dibayangkan. Episode pembuka ini memperkenalkan dunia penuh sihir, monster, dan humor satir yang menjadi ciri khas KonoSuba.

Namun, kecerdikan Takagi selalu membuat Nishikata menjadi sasaran godaan yang menghibur. Di balik persaingan yang penuh canda, keduanya perlahan menunjukkan kedekatan yang semakin berkembang, menghadirkan kisah romantis remaja yang hangat dan penuh humor.

programme.title: Eat With David (S1)

programme.title: Star Vs Food: Malaysia (S2)
programme.desc: Diana Danielle might be the darling of the masses on screen and Chef Edwin might look sweet but he knows how to melt sugar in his kitchen.

programme.title: Star Vs Food: Malaysia (S2)

programme.title: Delicious Japan (S1)

programme.title: Delicious Japan (S1)

programme.title: Go Where Flavors Of Hunan Abound (S2)

programme.title: The Fruit Nerd: Field To Feast (S1)

programme.title: The Fruit Nerd: Field To Feast (S1)
programme.desc: Thanh "The Fruit Nerd" Truong takes a deep dive into Australian tomatoes, more specifically Roma tomatoes, and enjoys a traditional Italian feast.

programme.title: Hidden Gem (S1)

programme.title: New Stirrings (S1)

programme.title: Old Taste Detective (S5)

programme.title: Food Feud (S1)

programme.title: Family Dinner (S1)

programme.title: Family Dinner (S1)

programme.desc: CAF Confederation: Zamalek vs ZESCO United mempertemukan Zamalek dari Egypt, salah satu kekuatan sepak bola Afrika dengan pengalaman kontinental dan kualitas serangan tinggi, dengan ZESCO United dari Zambia yang dikenal disiplin dan memiliki semangat kompetitif. Kedua tim memburu hasil penting di kompetisi antarklub Afrika.

programme.title: Mini Match UCL: ATM Vs TOT

programme.title: SFT Surf Foil World Tour 2026

programme.desc: Kwan Shan harus menyelamatkan wanita yang ia cintai, sebelum wanita itu dipersembahkan sebagai hadiah untuk seorang Jenderal!

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: Berlatar di masa Dinasti Han, sekelompok orang yang dipimpin oleh Yang Chi-ching dan Lin Dai, berupaya untuk memisahkan sang gubernur dengan putranya dan akhirnya menyebabkan mereka saling memusuhi.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: Kisah yang diangkat berdasarkan sebuah opera Tiongkok nan terkenal ini menceritakan seorang sarjana muda nan miskin bernama Zhang yang terpesona oleh Hong, putri dari keluarga berpengaruh yang ia temui di sebuah kuil.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: Seorang istri yang sakit parah bekerjasama dengan asisten rumah tangganya untuk membunuh sang suami yang kasar. Namun, hal ini menyebabkan serangkaian kejadian mengerikan.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Dokter Sing merasa bingung dengan gejala-gejala aneh yang dialami pasiennya dan meminta bantuan pada temannya. Penyakit tersebut rupanya disebabkan oleh ilmu hitam yang dilakukan oleh seorang pria jahat bernama Kong.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang dan putri Jin yang bernama Peony sudah bertunangan sejak lahir, tetapi Jin menolak pertunangan tersebut. Kemudian, Zhang bertemu dengan sesosok roh yang terlihat persis seperti Peony dan mereka jatuh cinta.

programme.title: The Pure And The Evil
programme.desc: Reuni dua teman SMA yang semula manis segera berubah menjadi mimpi buruk erotis yang mengerikan ketika Rose tertarik pada mantan teman sekelasnya, Fang, dan tunangan barunya!

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Sebuah film komedi romantis yang dibintangi oleh Liang Tien dan Chang Yin, yang berkisah tentang perseteruan lama antara seorang penipu pemula dan seorang penipu yang telah berpengalaman.

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: Di tahun 1973, bursa saham meroket, namun masalah-masalah sosial di Hong Kong terus memburuk. Bintang-bintang besar TVB dan Shaw Brothers bersatu dalam kisah yang lucu ini.

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: Enchanted Shadow terdiri dari tiga kisah. Suami dan istri yang harus berhati-hati dengan apa yang mereka inginkan, hantu perempuan tanpa busana yang ingin balas dendam dan wanita tuna susila yang menjadi hantu.

programme.title: The Story Of Sue San
programme.desc: Wang adalah putra pejabat pemerintah yang dihormati, sedangkan Sue San adalah seorang wanita penghibur nan terkenal. Meskipun dan terlihat cocok dan saling mencintai, keduanya sangat berbeda dalam tingkatan sosial.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Seorang ahli bela diri licik mengincar para pendekar pedang muda berbakat. Ia menantang mereka dengan taruhan bahwa pihak yang kalah harus memotong lengannya sendiri, lalu mengalahkan mereka menggunakan jurus rahasia yang tak mampu mereka tangkis. Namun, salah satu korban terdahulunya memutuskan bahwa sudah saatnya menghentikan semua itu.

programme.title: Apartment For Ladies
programme.desc: Betty Ting Pei berperan sebagai seorang penyanyi Taiwan yang datang ke Hong Kong untuk mencari adiknya yang hilang. Ia hampir diperkosa oleh geng jalanan dan diselamatkan oleh seorang komposer tampan.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Seorang panglima perang Tiongkok menyewa seorang tukang sihir untuk membantunya mengesankan selirnya yang menolak.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: Satpam Lee Go ditugaskan untuk menjaga sebuah rumah saat pemiliknya pergi. Namun, serangkaian kesalahpahaman lucu terjadi.

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: Wong Fei-Hung adalah seorang pemuda yang nakal namun saleh, tetapi setelah serangkaian insiden, ayahnya yang frustrasi menyuruh seorang guru bela diri mabuk untuk mendisiplinkannya.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Bintang laga Chow Yun-Fat memerankan gangster sungguhan Chen Daqi saat ia naik ke eselon atas kekuasaan, mendapati dirinya terpecah antara cinta dua wanita, rencana pembunuhan dinas rahasia, dan ancaman perang yang membayangi.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: Seorang gadis muda bertemu dengan seorang novelis di sebuah bar dan langsung jatuh cinta padanya. Namun, ternyata ia malah terperangkap ke dalam jebakan yang direkayasa oleh si novelis dan mantan kekasihnya.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Di Cina tahun 1920-an, seorang bandit tiba di kota provinsi terpencil dengan menyamar sebagai wali kota baru, di mana ia berhadapan dengan bangsawan lokal yang kejam.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Paman Hua adalah pensiunan agen yang memiliki toko barang antik di sebuah jalan tua. Namun, jalan itu dihancurkan secara paksa oleh Geng Naga Hijau setempat, dan membuat identitas Paman Hua tak sengaja terungkap.

programme.title: Girl With The Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: Lily, adalah seorang gadis biasa yang menjalani kehidupan sederhana. Suatu hari, dalam sebuah pasar antik, dia menemukan sepasang sepatu kaca berlian yang indah. Tanpa disangka, sepatu ini ternyata memiliki kekuatan magis yang dapat mewujudkan impian dan memberikan keberuntungan. Ketika Lily mencoba sepatu tersebut, dia segera menemukan bahwa hidupnya mulai berubah drastis. Dia mendapatkan pekerjaan impiannya, bertemu dengan orang-orang penting, dan bahkan menarik perhatian seorang pangeran modern yang tampan.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: Berfokus pada migrasi Ip Man ke Hong Kong pada tahun 1949 saat ia berupaya menyebarkan disiplin ilmu bela diri Wing Chun yang dianutnya.

programme.title: How To Choose A Royal Bride
programme.desc: Kaisar muda Kangxi sedang berusaha memilih seorang istri. Ibunya telah mengatur agar beberapa wanita muda yang tersedia mengunjunginya sehingga ia dapat memilih.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, putra dari pengusaha yang culun, mendapat kekecewaan usai mencari jodoh di Hawaii bersama temannya. Kemudian, secara tak sengaja mereka terjebak dalam sebuah pertukaran identitas yang kacau.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: Film ini berkisah tentang seorang pemadam kebakaran yang rela menerjang bahaya dan mempertaruhkan nyawanya demi menyelamatkan orang lain. Akan tetapi, apakah ia memiliki keberanian untuk menghadapi masalah pribadinya?

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: Seorang pengusaha serakah dari Hong Kong menyewa seorang pemburu muda untuk menangkap gorila raksasa yang konon hidup jauh di dalam hutan India. Pemburu itu menemukan kera tersebut, dan hidup bersamanya ia menemukan seorang wanita liar yang telah berteman dengan makhluk itu.

programme.title: The Monkey Is Back
programme.desc: Monyet Batu, memberikan harapan kepada seorang gadis kecil nan putus asa. Namun, Monyet Batu dikalahkan dalam pertempuran melawan Dewa Perang bermata tiga, yang membuatnya kehilangan kekuatan dan jatuh ke dunia fana.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 2
programme.desc: Perampok kuburan menemukan vampir yang diawetkan. Saat mengangkut vampir anak, mantra yang mengikatnya hilang, dan ia berteman dengan penduduk setempat. Vampir orang tua terbangun dan melarikan diri. Tabib herbal mengejar untuk menghancurkan mereka.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey 2: Cinderella
programme.desc: Kelanjutan kisah penuh lika-liku dari Raja Kera yang kini telah menjadi manusia dan memiliki kemampuan menjelajah waktu. Dalam usahanya memenuhi takdir ilahinya, ia harus menghadapi berbagai tantangan dan pengorbanan di sepanjang perjalanannya.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: Seorang wanita diperkosa dan dibunuh selama Perang Dunia II. Empat puluh tahun kemudian, ia kembali untuk menghantui para penganiayanya dari Rumah Besar Tao Tao. Seorang profesor dan keluarganya pindah ke rumah itu, hanya untuk kemudian roh-roh tersebut mengambil putra mereka.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Dokumenter ini menyoroti para master Kung Fu Tiongkok yang terkenal di industri film, memamerkan warisan Kung Fu Hong Kong selama enam puluh tahun dan mengabadikan kehidupan mereka yang penuh tantangan.

programme.title: China 24
programme.desc: Temukan berita terbaru tentang kehidupan di Tiongkok, mulai dari isu-isu sosial, teknologi dan olahraga hingga laporan khusus tentang peristiwa-peristiwa besar.

programme.title: Global Business

programme.title: Coventry Rising : PL Stories
programme.desc: We follow Coventry City as they prepare for a long-awaited return to the Premier League, ending a 25-year absence from English football's top flight. With exclusive access during the club's pre-season training camp in Malaga, we go behind the scenes as players and staff build towards a landmark campaign filled with anticipation and expectation.? Alongside the preparations for the future, we reflect on the remarkable journey that has brought the Sky Blues back to the Premier League. From unforgettable highs to painful setbacks, financial turmoil to remarkable resurgence, we explore the defining moments that have shaped one of English football's most resilient clubs.

programme.title: The Ipswich Way : PL Stories
programme.desc: From the trailblazing success of Sir Alf Ramsey's league champions to Sir Bobby Robson's unforgettable FA Cup and UEFA Cup triumphs, this is the story of one of English football's most cherished clubs. We celebrate the remarkable highs, the resilience through changing times, and George Burley's extraordinary achievement in guiding Ipswich Town to a fifth-place finish in their first Premier League season. As a new chapter begins with Gary O'Neil following the successful reign of Kieran McKenna, we explore how the spirit, identity and ambition of Ipswich Town continues to shape its future.

programme.title: The Tigers Return : PL Stories
programme.desc: Hull City's return to the Premier League is the latest chapter in a story built on resilience, ambition and belief.? We look back on the club's previous adventures in the top-flight, reliving the moments that shaped its identity before looking ahead to an exciting new era. Joining the Tigers at their pre-season training camp in Slovenia, we go behind the scenes to discover how the club is preparing for the challenges ahead, as they aim not just to survive in the Premier League, but to establish themselves there for years to come.

programme.desc: Meral (8) baru saja pindah ke sebuah kota baru. programme.title: Lele Hati Ini Meyakinkanmu, Cinta Ini Mematilku
programme.desc: Seorang pemuda tampan bernama Argo. Diceritakan kalau Argo ini tiba-tiba diputuskan pacarnya, setelah dia kalah balapan. Jadi ibaratnya, Argo sedang mengalami hal buruk bertubi-tubi atau sudah jatuh tertimpa tangga pula. Argo pun dianggap sebagai pecundang. Sampai pada akhirnya, Argo bertemu dengan Nurlela si peternak lele cantik dan dia tiba-tiba mengaku, kalau peternak lele cantik ini adalah pacar barunya, kepada sang mantan. Sampai pada akhirnya mereka pun membuat kesepakatan, bahwa Argo akan melakukan apapun, agar si cantik mau menjadi pacar pura-puranya. Namun akhirnya menjadi bumerang bagi si cantik sendiri, karena dia ternyata dianggap sebagai tukang selingkuh oleh pacarnya yang asli. Sampai pada akhirnya ketahuanlah kebenarannya, bahwa Argo membohongi sang mantan pacar dan semua orang. Lantas bagaimana nasib Argo selanjutnya ya? Apakah dia akan dianggap sebagai pecundang selamanya?

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Sampai akhirnya sang buah hati Zahra divonis menderita sakit yang serius ditengah keluarga mereka yang masih serba kekurangan. Disaat bersamaan, Fathir tidak sengaja bertemu dengan mantannya Clara. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Condor's Nest

programme.title: Unnatural

programme.title: Intruder
programme.desc: Saat Oregon dilanda salah satu badai terparah, seorang pemain selo muda berdiam diri di apartemennya yang luas. Namun kemudian, ia menyadari bahwa sebenarnya ia tidak sendirian.

programme.title: Intruder
programme.desc: Saat Oregon dilanda salah satu badai terparah, seorang pemain selo muda berdiam diri di apartemennya yang luas. Namun kemudian, ia menyadari bahwa sebenarnya ia tidak sendirian.

programme.title: Operation Seawolf
programme.desc: Angkatan Laut Jerman dan kapal-kapal U-Boat yang tersisa bergabung untuk satu misi terakhir guna menyerang Amerika Serikat.

programme.title: While We Sleep
programme.desc: Setelah mengamati hasil pemindaian CAT abnormal yang sangat familiar pada seorang gadis berusia 13 tahun, ahli radiologi Nina Evanko berjuang untuk menemukan sumber gangguan tidur yang dialami gadis muda itu. Apa yang ia temukan lebih gelap dan aneh dari yang dapat ia bayangkan.

programme.title: No Man's Land
programme.desc: Setelah sebuah aksi main hakim sendiri saat patroli perbatasan berakhir fatal, seorang pria melarikan diri dengan menunggang kuda ke Meksiko demi mencari pengampunan dari ayah sang korban.

programme.title: Old Henry
programme.desc: Seorang petani menampung seorang pria yang terluka dengan tas berisi uang tunai. Ketika sekelompok orang datang untuk mengambil uang itu, dia harus memutuskan siapa yang bisa dipercaya. Saat mempertahankan diri dari pengepungan, dia mengungkapkan bakatnya sebagai penembak jitu yang membuat identitas aslinya dipertanyakan.

programme.title: Shut In
programme.desc: Saat seorang ibu muda dikurung di dalam sepen oleh mantan pacarnya yang kejam, ia harus menggunakan kecerdikannya untuk melindungi kedua anaknya dari bahaya yang mengerikan selagi ia mencari cara untuk kabur.

programme.title: American Boogeyman
programme.desc: Agen Kathleen McChesney dan Robert Ressler nan pemberani mengatur salah satu perburuan terbesar dalam sejarah untuk menangkap seorang pembunuh berantai paling terkenal di Amerika, Ted Bundy.

programme.title: Safer At Home
programme.desc: Dua tahun setelah pandemi, sekelompok teman mengadakan pesta daring nan liar. Usai mengonsumsi ekstasi, keadaan menjadi kacau dan keamanan rumah mereka menjadi lebih menakutkan daripada kekacauan di luar.

programme.title: Don't Suck
programme.desc: Kesempatan terakhir seorang komedian veteran untuk menjadi bintang membawanya ke jalan bersama seorang komedian muda yang mengungkap masa lalu yang tak terduga.

programme.title: The Forest (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Seorang wanita Amerika memasuki area Hutan Bunuh Diri di Jepang nan legendaris untuk mencari saudari kembarnya yang menghilang secara misterius.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Empat kura-kura ninja, yang dimutasi oleh zat asing misterius, harus bangkit dari selokan dan mempertahankan kota mereka melawan kekuatan jahat dari masa lalu dan masa kini.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible 3

programme.title: MASHA AND THE BEAR
programme.desc: Seekor beruang sirkus pensiunan menetap di hutan dan bersiap untuk kehidupan baru yang tenang dikelilingi oleh kedamaian dan ketenangan sampai dia diperkenalkan dengan seorang gadis kecil petualang bernama Masha. Masha adalah seorang gadis Rusia yang tinggal di hutan bersama babi, kambing, dan anjingnya.

programme.title: Doby And Disy - Hello Dreams
programme.desc: Mimpi mendorong kita untuk menciptakan masa depan yang lebih baik! Suatu hari di Hutan Sinar Matahari, Doby dan Disy mengetahui bahwa teman-teman mereka tidak bangun setelah tertidur. Jadi, mereka memutuskan untuk masuk ke dalam mimpi teman-temannya untuk menyelamatkan mereka dan di sana, mereka bertemu dengan Peri Mimpi.

programme.title: CoComelon English

programme.title: Little Baby Bum - Core Song English
programme.desc: Little Baby Bum adalah acara yang menyenangkan dan mendidik untuk anak-anak yang menampilkan lagu anak-anak klasik dan baru. Bersama teman dan keluarganya, Mia yang berusia 6 tahun mengalami dunia di sekitarnya melalui lagu dan terkadang sedikit sihir juga.

programme.title: Dino Pororo

programme.title: Curse Of Oak Island S12, Ep 25
programme.desc: Setelah banjir besar menghambat penggalian pada musim sebelumnya, Rick dan Marty Lagina bersama Fellowship of the Dig kembali melanjutkan pencarian harta karun legendaris Oak Island yang telah berlangsung selama bertahun-tahun. Dengan bantuan teknologi pengeboran mutakhir, pemetaan bawah tanah, dan temuan arkeologi terbaru, mereka menyelidiki poros-poros baru, rongga bawah tanah, serta berbagai artefak yang diyakini dapat mengarah ke Money Pit yang melegenda. Di tengah setiap penemuan yang memunculkan teka-teki baru, musim ini menghadirkan harapan terbesar bagi tim untuk semakin dekat mengungkap salah satu misteri harta karun paling terkenal di dunia.

programme.desc: Little hakka menceritakan tentang anak-anak dan alam. Ah liang dan amei, dua saudari hakka yang tinggal di kota chizhu, lingnan, menemukan seekor bangau yang terluka di lereng kebun lebah milik paman man, dan memutuskan untuk menyelamatkannya. DALAM SERI INI, ASH BERTUJUAN UNTUK MENCAPAI KEMENANGAN DI LIGA KALOS SAMBIL MENJELAJAHI BERBAGAI KOTA DAN BERTEMU DENGAN BANYAK TEMAN BARU. SAAT PETUALANGAN BERLANJUT, MEREKA MENGHADAPI BERBAGAI TANTANGAN, TERLIBAT DALAM PERTEMPURAN EPIK, DAN MENEMUI POKÉMON LEGENDARIS. programme.title: PLENTIS KENTUS
programme.desc: PLENTIS KENTUS ADALAH SEBUAH ANIMASI ANAK-ANAK ASAL INDONESIA YANG POPULER DENGAN LAGU-LAGU CERIA DAN PENUH SEMANGAT. MEREKA DICIPTAKAN SEBAGAI BENTUK INOVASI DALAM INDUSTRI MUSIK ANAK-ANAK DI INDONESIA. PLENTIS DAN KENTUS ADALAH DUA SAHABAT KARIB YANG MASIH DUDUK DI BANGKU SEKOLAH DASAR. KEDUANYA MEMILIKI MIMPI BESAR UNTUK MENJADI PENYANYI TERKENAL. MEREKA SUKA BERNYANYI, MENCIPTAKAN LAGU, DAN TAMPIL DI BERBAGAI ACARA. PETUALANGAN MEREKA PENUH DENGAN KESERUAN, PERSAHABATAN, DAN TENTU SAJA, BANYAK SEKALI LAGU-LAGU YANG BISA MEMBUAT ANAK-ANAK IKUT BERNYANYI DAN BERGOYANG.

programme.title: BEDU DAN ADUL
programme.desc: BEDU DAN ADUL ADALAH SEBUAH SERIAL FILM ANIMASI 3D TENTANG PETUALANGAN ANAK-ANAK DI KAWASAN PINGGIRAN JAKARTA YANG MULTIKULTURAL. KARAKTER ANAK YANG SELALU INGIN TAHU MEMBUAT MEREKA INGIN SELALU BEREKSPLORASI HINGGA KADANG MENIMBULKAN KEHEBOHAN

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: Serial madun menceritakan perjalanan hidup madun (16 tahun) dalam memperjuangkan cita-citanya menjadi pesepakbola. Ayahnya, syafei (50 tahun) keturunan medan sangat menginginkan anaknya menjadi ustadz. Karena itu. Syafei selalu menghalangi upaya madun mencapai cita-citanya itu. baginya, pilihan madun hanya satu. Yakni jadi ahli agama. Ibunya madun, yaitu kirana asli batavia serba salah, dia harus patuh pada suami anti bola. Namun di sisi lain ia juga tidak ingin menghalangi madun mewujudkan cita-citanya. Ia tak tega mengekang madun yang mencintai bola. Namun untuk mewujudkan mimpinya. madun menghadapi banyak persaingan.

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: Animasi dan lagu 3d berbahasa indonesia, cocomelon menciptakan dunia yang berpusat pada pengalaman sehari-hari anak kecil. selain membantu anak-anak prasekolah mempelajari huruf, angka, suara binatang, warna, dan banyak lagi. video tersebut memberikan pelajaran kehidupan prososial. memberi orang tua kesempatan untuk mengajar dan bermain dengan anak-anak mereka saat mereka menonton bersama.

Di sana, si kembar Jade dan Mica mendapati dunia mereka terbalik ketika orang tua mereka yang seorang penjelajah mempercayakan tiga telur Marsupilami misterius kepada mereka. Setelah menetas, kedua saudara ini harus kreatif untuk menyembunyikan teman-teman baru mereka—lagipula, tidak ada yang tahu keberadaan makhluk-makhluk energik ini, dan predator bisa saja mengintai di setiap sudut.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terikat Janji
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Terikat Janji (RCTI)

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terlanjur Mencintaimu

Sempat mengira bayinya telah meninggal, ia akhirnya mengungkap kebenaran dan menemukan harapan baru bersama Elio.

programme.title: Terlanjur Mencintaimu (RCTI)
programme.desc: Arumi, barista keliling, menikahi Rendi yang ternyata telah beristri dan memanfaatkannya demi keturunan. Setelah bayinya dikira meninggal, Arumi mengungkap fakta mengejutkan. Di tengah luka, ia menemukan harapan bersama Elio.

programme.desc: Adrian, miliarder muda yang punya segalanya namun merasa kosong, menemukan kembali arti hidup saat bertemu Lira, pemilik coffee shop sederhana yang mengubah cara pandangnya. programme.desc: Kanaya (Sandrinna Michelle) seorang gadis remaja yang populer di sekolah, namun di rumah ia hanyalah seorang kakak yang harus menjaga adiknya, Alisa (Giselle Irene), apalagi Alisa yang memutuskan untuk sekolah bersama Kanaya. Tidak hanya itu, di sekolah Kanaya harus berhadapan dengan cinta pertamanya Arga (Andy William) dan Dastan (Lazuardy Nasution), anak baru yang tengil di sekolah. Bagaimanakah nasib Kanaya selanjutnya? Sakiskan SINETRON TERBARU SEINDAH MASA REMAJA

programme.title: Seindah Masa Remaja
programme.desc: Kanaya menjalani masa SMA yang penuh warna sebagai kapten tim dance populer, hingga kedatangan adiknya, Alisa, mengubah segalanya. Di tengah persahabatan, cinta pertama, persaingan, dan rahasia yang harus disembunyikan, keduanya menghadapi perjalanan remaja yang menguji arti keluarga, mimpi, dan cinta.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: Sebuah pengkhianatan mengubah hidup Asti untuk selamanya. Kehilangan wajah, keluarga, dan kehidupan yang selama ini ia percaya, Asti bangkit dengan identitas baru untuk membongkar konspirasi yang menghancurkan hidupnya. Di balik setiap kebenaran yang terungkap, ia harus memilih antara membalas dendam atau memperjuangkan masa depan anak yang menjadi satu-satunya alasan ia bertahan hidup.

programme.title: Biarkan Hati Bicara
programme.desc: Mimpi bahagia arina (febby rastanty) berubah jadi ancaman saat hari pernikahannya bersama reno (randy jhon) dihancurkan oleh fico (rangga azof) yang dikuasai dendam keluarga! saksikan kisahnya dalam sinetron terbaru biarkan hati bicara

programme.title: Biarkan Hati Bicara
programme.desc: Sejak kecil, Arina hidup dalam bayang-bayang masa lalu yang kelam. Saat ia akhirnya menemukan harapan melalui pernikahan dengan pria yang dicintainya, takdir justru mempertemukannya dengan sebuah pengkhianatan yang mengubah hidupnya. Terjebak dalam keluarga yang dipenuhi dendam, rahasia, dan kebencian, Arina harus mengungkap kebenaran sebelum semuanya terlambat.

Kehilangan wajah, keluarga, dan kehidupan yang selama ini ia percaya, Asti bangkit dengan identitas baru untuk membongkar konspirasi yang menghancurkan hidupnya. Di balik setiap kebenaran yang terungkap, ia harus memilih antara membalas dendam atau memperjuangkan masa depan anak yang menjadi satu-satunya alasan ia bertahan hidup.

programme.title: Biarkan Hati Bicara
programme.desc: Mimpi bahagia arina (febby rastanty) berubah jadi ancaman saat hari pernikahannya bersama reno (randy jhon) dihancurkan oleh fico (rangga azof) yang dikuasai dendam keluarga! saksikan kisahnya dalam sinetron terbaru biarkan hati bicara

programme.title: Biarkan Hati Bicara
programme.desc: Sejak kecil, Arina hidup dalam bayang-bayang masa lalu yang kelam. Saat ia akhirnya menemukan harapan melalui pernikahan dengan pria yang dicintainya, takdir justru mempertemukannya dengan sebuah pengkhianatan yang mengubah hidupnya. Terjebak dalam keluarga yang dipenuhi dendam, rahasia, dan kebencian, Arina harus mengungkap kebenaran sebelum semuanya terlambat.

programme.title: Brentford Vs Spurs - Liga Inggris - Live
Liga Inggris (L)
programme.desc: Program ini menampilkan duel sengit antar klub papan atas dan tim penantang dengan intensitas tinggi, aksi pemain bintang, serta atmosfer stadion yang penuh gairah.

programme.title: Sinema Dini Hari
programme.desc: Sinema Dini Hari menayangkan beragam film dari berbagai genre baik dari Indonesia maupun global.

programme.title: Barakallah
programme.desc: Setiap episode dihadirkan bersama pembawa acara dan bintang tamu yang berbagi kisah, pengalaman, dan solusi berdasarkan ajaran Islam mulai dari masalah rumah tangga, persahabatan, hingga tantangan sosial modern.

programme.title: Buser
programme.desc: Buser adalah program berita kriminal yang menyoroti berbagai kasus kejahatan yang terjadi di Indonesia.

programme.title: Liputan 6 Pagi (L)
programme.desc: Disiarkan setiap pagi, program ini menyajikan berita nasional, ekonomi, sosial, kriminal, serta inspirasi positif untuk memulai hari.

programme.title: Point Of View Spc. HUT SCTV
programme.desc: Point Of View Spc. HUT SCTV menghadirkan perbincangan spesial bersama para bintang dengan membahas pengalaman, pandangan, dan cerita menarik selama berkarier di dunia hiburan. Program ini juga menyuguhkan momen istimewa dalam perayaan hari ulang tahun SCTV.

programme.title: Halo Selebriti Spc. HUT SCTV
programme.desc: Halo Selebriti Spc. HUT SCTV hadir dengan berbagai informasi terbaru seputar kehidupan selebritas dan dunia hiburan Indonesia dalam rangka merayakan hari ulang tahun SCTV. Saksikan kisah menarik, momen spesial, serta kabar terkini dari para artis.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness mengisahkan keluarga Wu yang dipimpin oleh seorang perwira polisi beserta istrinya. Meski awalnya berharap memiliki seorang putra, mereka justru dikaruniai empat anak perempuan yang masing-masing menghadapi perjalanan hidup dan kisah cinta yang berbeda. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keluarga ini harus menghadapi berbagai konflik, mulai dari perselingkuhan, persaingan, ambisi, hingga rahasia yang menguji hubungan mereka. Di tengah berbagai cobaan tersebut, kasih sayang keluarga dan tekad untuk saling melindungi menjadi kekuatan utama dalam menghadapi setiap tantangan kehidupan.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan menyajikan berbagai kisah legenda, cerita rakyat, adat istiadat, kepercayaan tradisional, dan sejarah lokal yang membentuk identitas budaya Taiwan. Setiap episode mengungkap asal-usul tradisi, tokoh legendaris, perayaan budaya, hingga nilai-nilai yang diwariskan dari generasi ke generasi. Dengan perpaduan narasi, kunjungan ke lokasi bersejarah, dan eksplorasi budaya masyarakat setempat, program ini menghadirkan wawasan mendalam mengenai kekayaan warisan budaya Taiwan.

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef adalah salah satu program memasak paling populer di Taiwan yang telah menghibur pemirsa sejak 2006. Dipandu oleh Sam Tseng dan Genie Chuo bersama chef profesional James dan Wu Bing-Cheng, setiap episode menghadirkan demonstrasi memasak, kompetisi kuliner, tantangan bertema, serta kehadiran bintang tamu dari kalangan selebritas. Selain menyuguhkan hiburan yang ringan dan penuh humor, acara ini juga membagikan berbagai resep, teknik memasak, dan tips praktis yang dapat diterapkan di rumah.

programme.title: Top Singers
programme.desc: Top Singers menghadirkan para penyanyi berbakat yang menunjukkan kemampuan vokal dan gaya musik mereka melalui berbagai penampilan menarik. Setiap episode menampilkan interpretasi lagu-lagu populer, kisah perjalanan musik para penyanyi, serta momen spesial yang memperlihatkan bakat dan karakter unik masing-masing artis. Program ini menjadi wadah apresiasi bagi para musisi dan pecinta musik.

programme.title: Love Now
programme.desc: Love Now mengisahkan Yang Yi Ru, seorang eksekutif periklanan yang terlalu fokus pada pekerjaannya hingga membuat keluarga dan sahabatnya khawatir. Demi memaksanya beristirahat, mereka membuatnya percaya bahwa usianya tidak akan lama lagi. Dalam perjalanan yang dijalaninya, Yi Ru bertemu Lan Shi De dan perlahan menjalin hubungan yang penuh kehangatan. Di tengah berbagai kesalahpahaman, konflik keluarga, dan tantangan hidup, keduanya belajar tentang arti cinta, kepercayaan, dan pentingnya menghargai setiap momen dalam kehidupan.

programme.title: Battle Tour
programme.desc: Battle Tour mengajak para selebritas untuk berkompetisi menyusun rencana perjalanan dengan tema dan anggaran tertentu. Dalam setiap episode, mereka mengunjungi berbagai destinasi wisata, mencicipi kuliner khas, serta memperkenalkan tempat-tempat menarik yang layak dikunjungi. Melalui pengalaman seru, interaksi yang menghibur, dan rekomendasi perjalanan yang praktis, program ini memberikan inspirasi wisata bagi para penonton.

programme.title: Venus Online
programme.desc: Venus Online adalah program talk show gaya hidup dari Sanlih E-Television yang membahas berbagai isu menarik seputar kehidupan modern. Dalam setiap episode, para host bersama bintang tamu dan pakar mengulas tren kecantikan, fashion, kesehatan, hubungan, keluarga, hingga pengembangan diri melalui diskusi yang ringan namun informatif. Dikemas secara interaktif dan menghibur, acara ini memberikan inspirasi sekaligus tips praktis yang dapat diterapkan dalam kehidupan sehari-hari.

programme.title: Girls Tease
programme.desc: Diproduksi oleh Sanlih E-Television, Girls Tease adalah program talk show yang mengangkat berbagai topik seputar kehidupan perempuan masa kini. Dipandu oleh Tien Hsin dan Fabien Yang, setiap episode menghadirkan selebritas, pakar, serta perwakilan masyarakat untuk berbagi pengalaman dan berdiskusi mengenai tren kecantikan, fashion, percintaan, karier, kesehatan, hingga berbagai tantangan yang dihadapi perempuan urban. Dikemas dengan suasana santai, interaktif, dan penuh humor, acara ini menyuguhkan informasi sekaligus hiburan yang relevan bagi penonton modern.

programme.desc: Jeanne jatuh cinta kepada Jean, seorang pemuda pemberontak yang tidak pernah merasa nyaman dengan kehidupan yang dijalaninya. programme.desc: Twelve year-old Chloe is feeling somewhat disillusioned. Then Potobot, a little robot arrives from the future with a mission for her: to change the world and make the future a better place. There's no doubt about it, working together, one step after another, the two of them can move mountains!

programme.title: POTOBOT
programme.desc: POTOBOT menghadirkan perjalanan menarik ke dunia kreativitas digital yang memadukan teknologi dan seni visual. Setiap episode menampilkan teknik eksperimental, seniman muda, serta evolusi seni lukis di era digital. Dengan visual yang imersif dan pembahasan mendalam, program ini menunjukkan bagaimana teknologi modern mengubah ekspresi artistik.

programme.title: Cirkus

programme.title: Les Super-Pouvoirs Du Vivant
programme.desc: The animal kingdom is brimming with creatures that have extraordinary powers. To reveal the incredible inventiveness of nature and the importance of protecting it, each episode takes us on a fascinating journey rich in poetry and humour.

programme.desc: Les Super-Pouvoirs du Vivant adalah dokumenter sains yang mengajak penonton menjelajahi berbagai kemampuan menakjubkan yang dimiliki makhluk hidup di bumi. Dari hewan dengan indera luar biasa dan strategi bertahan hidup unik hingga tumbuhan serta organisme yang mampu beradaptasi dengan kondisi ekstrem, film ini memperlihatkan keajaiban evolusi dan keanekaragaman hayati. Dengan bantuan penelitian para ilmuwan dan gambar-gambar alam yang memukau, dokumenter ini mengungkap bagaimana alam menciptakan berbagai solusi cerdas untuk menjaga kelangsungan hidup.

programme.desc: Les Secrets du Finistère mengisahkan Morgane Le Dantec yang kembali ke Brittany dan terlibat dalam penyelidikan setelah ditemukannya tulang-belulang manusia di bawah pohon ek suci yang tumbang akibat badai. Korban ternyata memiliki kaitan dengan tradisi druidisme, sebuah dunia yang pernah dikenal Morgane semasa muda. Dalam upayanya mengungkap kebenaran, ia harus kembali berhadapan dengan teman-teman lama dan berbagai rahasia masa lalu yang selama ini tersembunyi. Memadukan investigasi kriminal dengan mitologi dan legenda khas Brittany, film ini menghadirkan misteri yang penuh ketegangan sekaligus menyingkap hubungan antara masa lalu dan masa kini.

programme.title: Alterrenative Voyages
programme.desc: We're off to Brignoles in the Var to meet Corinne Lafortune, Circular Economy Project Coordinator at Ecoscience Provence. The association's primary objective is to reduce waste! We also visited the Bulles de Coco eco-friendly soap factory and the La Courtoisie recycling centre.

programme.title: ALTERRENATIVE VOYAGES
programme.desc: Dokumenter perjalanan yang menampilkan cara unik dan berkelanjutan dalam menjelajahi destinasi, dengan fokus pada budaya, lingkungan, dan hubungan manusia yang autentik.

programme.title: Le Choix Du Pianiste
programme.desc: Oscar Lesage, Pia Lagrange, Zoe Adjani-Vallat, Philippe Torreton

programme.title: LE CHOIX DU PIANISTE
programme.desc: Le Choix du Pianiste mengisahkan François Touraine, seorang pianis virtuoso Prancis yang hidupnya berubah drastis ketika Perang Dunia II pecah. Demi melindungi Rachel, perempuan Yahudi yang ia cintai, François terpaksa menerima kesempatan untuk bermain musik di Jerman pada masa kekuasaan Nazi. Keputusan tersebut membawanya ke dalam konflik batin yang mendalam antara cinta, moralitas, dan kelangsungan hidup. Setelah perang berakhir dan ia kembali ke Prancis, François harus menghadapi luka emosional serta konsekuensi dari pilihan-pilihan yang pernah ia buat. Pertemuannya dengan Annette memberinya kesempatan untuk bangkit kembali dan menemukan harapan baru. Dengan latar sejarah yang kuat, film ini menghadirkan kisah tentang cinta, pengorbanan, keberanian, dan kekuatan musik di tengah masa-masa paling kelam dalam sejarah Eropa.

programme.title: Legend Of Kitchen Soldier, Ep 9
programme.desc: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier mengisahkan Kang Seong-jae, seorang pemuda dari keluarga sederhana yang memutuskan masuk militer setelah kematian ayahnya. Meski menjadi lulusan terbaik selama pelatihan, ia justru ditempatkan di bagian dapur karena pengalamannya membantu usaha food truck milik sang ayah. Kehidupannya berubah ketika sebuah sistem misterius layaknya permainan video muncul dan memberinya berbagai misi memasak. Setiap tantangan yang berhasil diselesaikan membuat kemampuan memasaknya berkembang pesat hingga ia menjadi sosok yang dihormati oleh rekan-rekan dan atasannya. Di balik kisah penuh humor dan semangat kebersamaan di barak militer, Seong-jae juga perlahan menemukan petunjuk tentang rahasia yang mungkin berkaitan dengan kematian ayahnya. Serial ini memadukan komedi, fantasi, dunia kuliner, dan kisah pertumbuhan diri dalam sebuah petualangan yang menghibur dan hangat.

programme.desc: Jung-Han believes Eun-Ae is ill because of Ms. Ma. Meanwhile, Ji-Young prepares her daughter's birthday party.

programme.title: Fortune Salon
programme.desc: Tae-rang is a successful upscale clairvoyant with not only gifted shamanistic talent but also good looks. Yet fate has it that she is destined to marry Seung-won the most unattractive and lazy man she has ever met.

programme.title: Love Lies
programme.desc: Two friends fall apart as they compete their love for music romance and the chance to become Joseon's voice.

programme.title: Shades of The Heart
programme.desc: One spring writer Chang-seok leaves his wife in the UK and returns to Seoul after 7 years. As walking around he keeps thinking that everything looks different from the past. His story which may be real or not gets built up by meeting Mi-young a woman who lost time Yoo-jin an editor who burns memories Sung-ha a photographer who seeks hope and Joo-eun a bartender who buys memories.

programme.title: Lovers' Concerto
programme.desc: Ji-hwan a college student befriends two cute girls his age. Over the years he loses contact with them and learns a surprising secret about the two.

programme.title: Iris: The Movie
programme.desc: South Korean National Security Service normally deals with North Korea but now NSS must deal with IRIS terrorists with a nuke.

programme.title: Juug Gone Wrong
programme.desc: Two cousins with similar hustles but different methods come up with what they believe to be the perfect juug - until it goes wrong.

programme.title: Get the Girl
programme.desc: When a strange girl appears do you help, or mind your business? A retired hitman and his trainee get pulled into the shit when they decide to save a girl who escapes from trafficking. Sometimes you gotta do bad things to bad people.

programme.title: Xanadu Hellfire
programme.desc: A nine-year-old brings a warrior from the future to the present and an evil follows. An amazingly cool and funny Sci-fi comedy with kids cursing, lasers, time travel, aliens, martial arts, and more!

programme.title: A Rough Draft
programme.desc: A video game designer is stripped of his identity and recruited by a mysterious force to be the gatekeeper of a multi-dimensional portal.

programme.title: Awaken
programme.desc: Cafe owner Alex's love life is ignited when Rachel walks through his doors. What begins as a shot of love quickly spins into a mystery spanning space and time when Alex discovers the woman of his dreams may only exist in his dreams.

programme.title: Rain Beau's End
programme.desc: When a progressive lesbian couple adopts a boy with a misunderstood genetic condition that was thought to predispose boys to violence and criminality, they must come to grips with their hardline stance on acceptance and toxic masculinity.

programme.title: Slant
programme.desc: Melbourne. 1999. Christmas time! In this darkly comic thriller, a rogue journalist unearths the sordid secrets of an infamous missing socialite for the scoop of a lifetime while unwittingly dredging up his family trauma.

programme.title: Molli and Max in the Future
programme.desc: A sci-fi rom-com about a man and woman whose orbits repeatedly collide over the course of 12 years, 4 planets, 3 dimensions, and 1 space-cult. Molli and Max in the Future combines character-driven romance with an eclectic sci-fi universe.

programme.title: Retribution
programme.desc: Dan's mission becomes a race against time to ensure that in Retribution - everybody pays.

programme.title: Iceman: Book One
programme.desc: Known as Iceman, a newly retired organized crime fixer is pulled back deeper than ever.

programme.title: All Superheroes Must Die
programme.desc: Four Super Heroes find themselves abducted by their Arch Nemesis and are forced to compete in a series of challenges in order to save an abandoned town full of kidnapped innocent civilians.

programme.title: The Pilgrim's Progress
programme.desc: This classic story of a man's remarkable journey towards God is brought to life for a new generation of believers through state-of-the-art animation.

programme.title: Kensuke's Kingdom
programme.desc: Young Michael and his dog wash up on a remote island when a violent storm sweeps them overboard during a sailing trip. Believing he's all alone, Michael is surprised to discover a mysterious Japanese man who's lived on the island since World War II. Initially suspicious of each other, the boy and the old man must soon join forces when dangerous invaders threaten their fragile paradise.

programme.title: Love You Right: An R&B Musical
programme.desc: When a series of events causes Will Clay's career as a successful R&B artist to hit rock bottom, he is forced to heal and come to grips with lessons on loyalty and love.

programme.title: Jones Plantation
programme.desc: This harrowing tale explores the tangled roots of exploitation and control through one man's nefarious quest to maintain power through elaborate deception. But even the best cons must eventually come to light...

programme.title: Badland
programme.desc: A young soldier unable to process the horrors of war he experienced in Iraq, returns home only to commit his own horrors.

programme.title: Turn of the Cheek
programme.desc: The concept of forgiveness becomes unimaginable when one family is torn between facing their son's murderer and being compelled to help an innocent child whose life is caught in the balance.

programme.title: Succuba
programme.desc: An evil presence attaches to a lonely widower who intends to guard it for as long as he can.

programme.title: Asperger's Are Us
programme.desc: In this coming-of-age documentary, four friends on the Autism spectrum who have bonded through humor and performed as the comedy troupe "Asperger's Are Us" will prepare for one final, ambitious show before going their separate ways.

programme.title: Boulevard! A Hollywood Story
programme.desc: Dickson Hughes and Richard Stapley, two young songwriters and romantic partners, find themselves caught in movie star Gloria Swanson's web when she hires them to write a musical version of "Sunset Boulevard."

programme.title: Kung Fu Brother
programme.desc: Three cops and a reporter pursue a murderer who's hellbent on acquiring sacred scrolls. As they chase the murderer far and wide, they must find a way to take him down before he gets his hands on the scrolls.

programme.title: Checkered Ninja
programme.desc: A possessed Ninja doll teams up with a shy teenager to avenge the murder of a poor child factory worker. Alex learns courage enough to vanquish the school bully and score points with his crush.

programme.title: A Quiet Passion
programme.desc: Explores the early life of Emily Dickinson as a schoolgirl to her later years as a reclusive but unknown talent and her attachments to her family.

programme.title: The Final Contestant
programme.desc: After her family business is robbed, Norah Jeffries plans a city-wide talent show to recover from it. News of the show attracts talented performers who, like Norah, face the harsh reality of bullying.

programme.title: Breakfast of Champions
programme.desc: An unhappy car dealer (Bruce Willis) believes that a dime-store author/philosopher (Albert Finney) has the answers to life's important questions.

programme.title: Spotlight
programme.desc: In 2001, editor Marty Baron of The Boston Globe assigns a team of journalists to investigate allegations against John Geoghan, an unfrocked priest accused of molesting more than 80 boys. Led by editor Walter "Robby" Robinson (Michael Keaton), reporters Michael Rezendes (Mark Ruffalo), Matt Carroll and Sacha Pfeiffer interview victims and try to unseal sensitive documents. The reporters make it their mission to provide proof of a cover-up of sexual abuse within the Roman Catholic Church.

programme.title: Boyka: Undisputed 4
programme.desc: Boyka accidentally kills an opponent in the ring, forcing him to question everything he's worked for. When he finds out his opponent's widow is in trouble, he becomes her champion in a series of seemingly impossible fights.

programme.title: Paris Is Burning
programme.desc: This documentary focuses on drag queens living in New York City and their "house" culture, which provides a sense of community and support for the flamboyant and often socially shunned performers. Groups from each house compete in elaborate balls that take cues from the world of fashion. Also touching on issues of racism and poverty, the film features interviews with a number of renowned drag queens, including Willi Ninja, Pepper LaBeija and Dorian Corey.

programme.title: The Dead Girl
programme.desc: In a quintet of stories, the murder of a young runaway connects a group of unrelated women. Lonely Arden discovers the body; Leah, a forensics student, thinks the victim may be her long-missing sister. Melora arrives in Los Angeles to piece together the last days of her daughter's life, while Ruth makes a disturbing discovery in the storage facility she and her husband manage.

programme.title: College
programme.desc: Brilliant in his studies and dismissive of athletics, Ronald (Buster Keaton) finishes high school at the top of his class. But in college his uptight attitude doesn't win him any points with his sports-loving classmates, and pretty coed Mary (Anne Cornwall) ignores him in favor of brutish jock Jeff (Harold Goodwin). Hoping to impress Mary, Ronald makes a buffoon of himself at every sport imaginable, usually at Jeff's hand. But Ronald gets a final shot at glory in a big rowing race.

programme.title: Masquerade
programme.desc: Eleven-year-old Casey is home alone -- until a group of intruders, led by Rose, breaks in. They plan to steal her family's priceless collection of artworks, but their reckless ambition is outmatched only by Rose's opportunism. As the stakes grow even higher, Casey now finds herself in a fight for her life as the invaders prove they'll stop at nothing to get what they want.

programme.title: Bloodfist III: Forced to Fight
programme.desc: An innocent half-Asian kickboxer is caught between two other races at war in prison.

programme.title: A Better Tomorrow II
programme.desc: A policeman (Leslie Cheung) and a reformed gangster (Ti Lung) meet their dead friend's twin, employed by a New York mob boss.

programme.title: Man of the Year
programme.desc: Tom Dobbs (Robin Williams), the satirical host of a political talk show, decides to shake things up by running for president after making comments that he would be a better president than the leader who currently occupies the White House. His fans begin a grassroots campaign that catapults him into the Oval Office, but soon after moving in it is revealed a computer glitch mistakenly awarded him the presidency. Tom is left with a tough choice, stay the course or head back behind the microphone.

programme.title: Downfall
programme.desc: In 1942, young Traudl Junge (Alexandra Maria Lara) lands her dream job -- secretary to Adolf Hitler (Bruno Ganz) at the peak of his power. Three years later, Hitler's empire is now his underground bunker. The real-life Traudl narrates Hitler's final days as he rages against imagined betrayers and barks orders to phantom armies, while his mistress, Eva Braun (Juliane Köhler), clucks over his emotional distance, and other infamous Nazis prepare for the end.

programme.title: The Compleat Al
programme.desc: A colorful reality marries an equally vivid imagination in a hilarious portrait of musician-satirist Alfred Matthew "Weird Al" Yankovic's personal life and career.

programme.title: Legacy of Rage
programme.desc: Sentenced to prison for a crime he did not commit, a man sets out for revenge after his release from jail.

programme.title: Battle Beyond the Stars
programme.desc: Shad of Akir (Richard Thomas) recruits a space cowboy (George Peppard) and other warriors to defend his planet from a barbarian's army.

programme.title: Pete's Meteor
programme.desc: Lives change for members of an Irish family after a meteor crashes in their backyard.

programme.title: FernGully ... the Last Rainforest
programme.desc: Crysta is a fairy who lives in FernGully, a rainforest in Australia, and has never seen a human before. In fact, she is told they are extinct. But when a logging company comes near the rainforest, she sees that they do exist, and even accidentally shrinks one of them: a boy named Zak. Now her size, Zak sees the damage that the company does and helps Crysta to stop not only them, but an evil entity named Hexxus, who feeds off pollution.

programme.title: Hitman
programme.desc: A fast talker (Eric Tsang) engages a Hong Kong rube (Jet Li) to track down the assassin of a sleazy Japanese businessman.

programme.title: Rosewater
programme.desc: In June 2009, BBC journalist Maziar Bahari, an Iranian-born Canadian citizen, returned to his native country to interview Mir-Hossein Moussavi, the prime challenger to incumbent President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad. When Moussavi's supporters protested Ahmadinejad's declaration of victory, Bahari smuggled footage of the riots to the BBC. He was soon arrested by the Revolutionary Guard and -- led by a man known only as "Rosewater" -- was interrogated and tortured for 118 days.

programme.title: Before I Go to Sleep
programme.desc: Ever since a vicious attack nearly claimed her life, Christine Lucas (Nicole Kidman) has suffered from anterograde amnesia and is unable to form new memories. Every morning, she becomes reacquainted with her husband, Ben (Colin Firth), and the other constants in her life. In accordance with her doctor's (Mark Strong) instructions, Christine keeps a video diary. As Christine starts to uncover terrifying truths about her past, she begins to question everything -- and everyone -- around her.

programme.title: Karate Killer
programme.desc: Kiba is back again, but this time he has fallen from grace and been sent to prison for all the violent acts he has committed. Once he's out, he begins working as a bodyguard in a club that is crawling with gangsters.

programme.title: Chef
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Bodyguards and Assassins
programme.desc: In 1906 Hong Kong, a newspaper editor and a tycoon learn of an assassination plot against Sun Yat-sen, and recruit a small band of ordinary men and women to protect him.

programme.title: The Eagle Has Landed
programme.desc: During World War II, Nazi officer Max Radl devises a plan to kidnap or kill the British prime minister. Approved by German Cmdr. Heinrich Himmler, the scheme moves forward with Col. Kurt Steiner leading the mission, aided by Liam Devlin, an Irishman with a deep hatred of England. As the plan unfolds, it seems to be going well -- until certain events threaten the group's shot at success.

programme.title: The Man Who Knew Too Much
programme.desc: On a family vacation in Switzerland, Bob (Leslie Banks) and his wife, Jill (Edna Best), become friendly with a man staying in their hotel. When the stranger is assassinated in their presence, the vacation turns dangerous. Before dying, the stranger passes along a secret to Jill. Then, to keep the couple silent, a band of foreign assassins kidnaps their daughter. Offered no help by the police, Bob and Jill hunt for their daughter as they try to understand the information that they have.

programme.title: Red Riding: 1980
programme.desc: Six years after his first visit to Yorkshire, England, detective Peter Hunter (Paddy Considine) returns to look into the town's high murder rate. Though the deaths have been occurring with alarming regularity over the years, the police have done little to find the killer, who's now known as the Yorkshire Ripper. As Hunter discovers mysterious irregularities in the case, he realizes corrupt police officers (David Morrissey, Warren Clarke) are doing everything they can to stop his investigation.

programme.title: Breathing Lessons
programme.desc: When the husband of their friend Serena (Joyce Van Patten) dies, Ira (James Garner) and Maggie Moran (Joanne Woodward), an older married couple, make an event out of their day's travel to the funeral. Examining life and marriage on their journey, the couple of 29 years remains as in love today as when they first met -- despite being near opposites in personality. However, their love and respect for one another cut through all the differences between them.

programme.title: Sweet Nothing in My Ear
programme.desc: A man (Jeff Daniels) wants to restore his son's (Noah Valencia) hearing with surgery, but his deaf wife (Marlee Matlin) opposes the plan.

programme.title: Guiding Emily
programme.desc: Emily's life changes forever after she loses her eyesight, while a guide dog struggles with training. Through a series of missed encounters, both overcome obstacles and find each other.

programme.title: Plainsong
programme.desc: In rural Colorado, eight people (Aidan Quinn, Rachel Griffiths, America Ferrera), including two teachers, experience vast changes in their lives over the course of a year.

programme.title: Hailey Dean Mysteries: A Marriage Made for Murder
programme.desc: Hailey finds herself entangled in Atlanta's notorious "Black Widow" murder case and it will take all her personal resources to bring the killer to justice.

programme.title: A Wish Come True
programme.desc: On the night of her 30th birthday, Lindsay Corwin (Megan Park) wishes for all of her past wishes to come true.

programme.title: All Yours
programme.desc: Cass, a busy, single mother, hires her friend Matt to help her take care of the kids. Eventually, she realizes that the person who could complete her family may have been there the whole time.

programme.title: Pumpkin Everything
programme.desc: Amy Fox left her hometown of Autumnsboro, New Hampshire to chase her dream of becoming a novelist. She did so even when Tom Adams, her grandfather who loved her dearly, was not supportive.

programme.title: Love on Ice
programme.desc: Former figure skating champion, Emily James, now 27 years old and considered a relic in the world of figure skating, gets an improbably shot to reclaim skating glory when a young coach sees greatness in her.

programme.title: Love by Chance
programme.desc: Helen can't help but try to constantly play matchmaker for Claire, her beautiful daughter who believes love can only be found through fate and not a fix up. After Helen finally vows to avoid Claire's love life, she inadvertently meets Eric,a single thirty-something doctor. Helen arranges for him to secretly meet her daughter and the two quickly fall in love until Claire eventually learns the truth of her mother's involvement.

programme.title: Wedding Planner Mystery
programme.desc: Wedding planner Carnegie Kincaid has just landed the job that could propel her small business into the limelight. Nickie Parry's marriage to concert pianist Ray Ishigura promises to be the season's biggest high society wedding.

programme.title: Garage Sale Mysteries: Pilot
programme.desc: Jennifer loves scouring garage sales to look for items to sell in her resell shop, but when she realizes a series of burglaries and a friend's murder may have a connection to the sales, she not only helps the cops, but does some undercover sleuthing.

programme.title: Fixer Upper Mysteries: Framed for Murder
programme.desc: In the small resort town of Lighthouse Cove, everyone knows that the best man for the job is a woman. And that woman is Shannon Hammer, owner of Hammer Construction Company and an expert in Victorian home restoration and renovation.

programme.title: Along Came a Nanny
programme.desc: Hoping to catch a burglar, a cop goes undercover as a nanny in an upscale community. As he looks for leads, he becomes involved with a high-maintenance family and a pretty caregiver nearby.

programme.title: Kiss at Pine Lake
programme.desc: Luke Garvey, a philanthropic entrepreneur, buys his uncle's Camp Pine Lake for sentimental reasons only to find himself the new owner ofa sinking business. Zoe McConnell,Luke's girlfriend from camp years ago, is the point person in her development...

programme.title: Night Ride Home
programme.desc: Neal (Keith Carradine) and Nora (Rebecca De Mornay) are married, but distant with each other. The couple focus all their attention and love on their son, Simon (Jordan Brower), and daughter, Clea (Thora Birch). When Simon dies suddenly in a tragic horseback-riding accident, Nora takes the death especially hard and falls into a deep depression. With the help of Nora's mother, Maggie (Ellen Burstyn), Neal attempts to reconnect with his wife and save his family.

programme.title: Walking the Dog
programme.desc: Rival lawyers battle each other in court as their respective dogs fall madly in love, bringing their guardians together at every turn until they reluctantly realize it may not just be the pups who are each other's true Valentine.

programme.title: Wedding March 4: Something Old, Something New
programme.desc: Mick, Olivia and the rest of the Willow Lake Inn team help a couple set up the wedding of their dreams, but complications soon arise when the bride starts to have second thoughts about the plans.

programme.title: The Lost Child
programme.desc: Rebecca (Mercedes Ruehl) was adopted as a child and begins to wonder about her past after her mother dies. Her adoptive father's new wife takes no interest in her, and when several years later her father also passes away, she goes on a quest to find her biological parents. She eventually meets a Navajo woman and discovers they are siblings. Rebecca is overjoyed to discover her lost family, but her husband, Jack (Jamey Sheridan), has to struggle to adapt to this new reality.

programme.title: The Lost Valentine
programme.desc: A reporter (Jennifer Love Hewitt) seeks the truth about a woman's (Betty White) husband (Billy Magnussen), a pilot who never returned from duty in World War II.

programme.title: Mitch Albom's Have a Little Faith
programme.desc: Cleric Henry Covington (Laurence Fishburne) and Rabbi Albert Lewis (Martin Landau) profoundly affect the life of writer Mitch Albom (Bradley Whitford).

programme.title: Beyond the Blackboard
programme.desc: A 24-year-old first-time teacher overcomes her initil fears and prejudices to make a difference in the lives of the homelss children she teaches in a shelter's makeshift classroom. Stars Emily VanCamp, Treat Williams and Timothy Busfield.

programme.title: The Runaway
programme.desc: Following a mystic's (Maya Angelou) prophecies, the sheriff (Dean Cain) of a 1949 rural Georgia town reopens a murder case that may have been racially motivated.

programme.title: Pictures of Hollis Woods
programme.desc: Abandoned at birth and described as "a mountain of trouble," 12-year-old Hollis Woods has a history of running away from her foster homes. Edna, a patient, persistent and sometimes exasperated social worker, finally places Hollis in the home....

programme.title: Emma Fielding Mysteries: Site Unseen
programme.desc: Brilliant, dedicated, and driven, archaeologist Emma Fielding is trying to unearth evidence of a 17th century coastal Maine settlement that predates Jamestown, one of the most significant archaeological finds in years. But the dead body...

programme.title: Love, Of Course
programme.desc: When widowed mother Amy moves her only daughter, Cara to her out-of-state college dorm, Amy finds herself searching for the next step in her life. While at the university, Amy gets an offer she can't refuse and meets Noah...

programme.title: Surprised by Love
programme.desc: As a young businesswoman tries to convince her uptight parents to approve of her current boyfriend, she finds herself questioning her own life choices and falling for an old high school flame. Over her parents' 40th anniversary weekend...

programme.title: The Mystery Cruise
programme.desc: Alvirah, Regan and their husbands join a murder mystery cruise in honor of Regan's mom Nora's new book. But, when Alvirah sees a real murder attempt, she and Regan must find a way to keep the intended victim safe while trying to find proofto expose the murderer. Meanwhile, the ladies husbands have a mystery to solve as well when they run into a counterfeiter and are also called upon to help solve a string of petty thefts. Stars Gail O'Grady and Michelle Harrison.

programme.title: Signed, Sealed, Delivered
programme.desc: A mix up on her first day of work sends Shane to the Dead Letter Office, where a group of quirky characters led by Oliver try to deliver the undeliverable. Though Shane wants out of this strange detail, she can't help but get caught up inthe story...

programme.title: The Goode Family
programme.desc: Helen thinks she's finally won her father Charlie's approval when he adopts a bizarre animal named Gutterball from her pet rescue.

programme.title: Meteor
programme.desc: Dr Lehman and his assistant Imogene join forces to avert a looming disaster. They strive to divert a meteor hurtling towards Earth, determined to save humanity from impending doom.

programme.title: I'm Beginning to See the Light
programme.desc: After losing his family in a brutal accident, ex-trumpeter Ezra finds solace as a lighthouse keeper. But when two visitors reveal their true motives, Ezra must decide: let the light back into his life or stay in the shadows.

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: Stylebender
programme.desc: An intimate exploration of a bullied outsider's battle to the top of the UFC, revealing Israel Adesanya's brutal, beautiful struggle to become the global phenomenon known as 'The Last Stylebender.'

programme.title: Stolen
programme.desc: A former thief frantically searches for his missing daughter, who has been kidnapped and locked in the trunk of a taxi. Starring Nicolas Cage and Malin Akerman.

programme.title: Guardians
programme.desc: During the Cold War a secret organization created an elite squad of superheroes to defend the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Brother Orange
programme.desc: In 2014, BuzzFeed writer Matt Stopera's phone was stolen from a bar in New York City. A year later, photos of storefronts and a man next to an orange tree mysteriously appeared in his iPhoto stream. Matt wrote an article about it, and overnight, it went viral in China, where internet users identified the man as "Brother Orange." Matt became an instant celebrity, and as media followed their every move, he and Brother Orange formed a deep friendship that transcended cultural and language barriers.

programme.title: Roswell Delirium
programme.desc: The story of an alternate 1980s where the U.S. is hit by a wave of nuclear attacks, and after the fallout those who remain, pretend like everything is normal even though they are all experiencing radiation poisoning. A young girl named Mayday tries to make contact on a series of ham radios with her father who is in space on a shuttle mission. Instead of making contact she receives an intergalactic distress call from space that leads her on a journey to Spacerock, the land where Area 51 once was.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Journey to the End of the Night
programme.desc: Sinatra and his adult son, Paul, live on the edge of the law in the Brazilian urban jungle of São Paulo. They make a meager living running a brothel, but what profits they make Paul gambles away. When a customer dies on their premises, leaving behind a suitcase brimming with drugs, Sinatra sees a way to start a new life for his new wife and her young child. But his scheme quickly gets complicated when Paul sees the opportunity to take a calculated risk.

programme.title: Shiver Me Timbers
programme.desc: In Northern California during the summer of 1986, Olive Oyl, along with her cinema-obsessed friends and brother Castor, embark on a once-in-a-lifetime camping trip to witness the dazzling meteor shower accompanying the arrival of Halley's comet. But what starts as a serene evening of stargazing quickly turns into a harrowing nightmare when a meteor from the comet transforms Popeye, into a terrifying and unstoppable killing machine.

programme.title: Season Of The Witch
programme.desc: His faith broken by many years fighting in the Crusades, a knight named Behman returns to Europe and finds it ravaged by the Black Plague. A dying cardinal orders Behman and his friend, Felson, to take an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will destroy her powers and end the pestilence. As Behman and five comrades undertake the dangerous journey, they come to realize that the prisoner is no ordinary girl, and evil forces await at the destination.

programme.title: Stylebender
programme.desc: An intimate exploration of a bullied outsider's battle to the top of the UFC, revealing Israel Adesanya's brutal, beautiful struggle to become the global phenomenon known as 'The Last Stylebender.'

programme.title: CAT 8
programme.desc: A research program once abandoned by the best solar physicist when the Pentagon wanted to put it to military use, has been resumed by his former deputy.

programme.title: The Infiltrator [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1986, federal agent Robert Mazur (Bryan Cranston) goes undercover to infiltrate the trafficking network of Colombian drug kingpin Pablo Escobar. Working with fellow agents Kathy Ertz (Diane Kruger) and Emir Abreu (John Leguizamo), Mazur poses as a slick, money-laundering businessman named Bob Musella. Gaining the confidence of Roberto Alcaino (Benjamin Bratt), Escobar's top lieutenant, Mazur must navigate a vicious criminal underworld where one wrong move could cost him everything.

programme.title: Trespass
programme.desc: Fast-talking diamond dealer Kyle Miller (Nicolas Cage) and his wife, Sarah (Nicole Kidman), live the good life in a beautiful home surrounded by thick woods. Their dream life turns into a nightmare when violent thieves, led by Elias (Ben Mendelsohn), invade their home disguised as police officers. With Kyle and Sarah now frightened captives, Kyle knows he must use every negotiating trick in his book, for once Elias and his men get what they want, the Millers will likely be killed.

programme.title: Donovan's Echo
programme.desc: When a series of uncanny deja vu events begin to occur, a man must re-examine his tragic past and instinct.

programme.title: Donnie Darko (Director's Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a funny, moving and distinctly mind-bending journey through suburban America, one extraordinary but disenchanted teenager is about to take Time's Arrow for a ride. When Walker's wife, Melissa (Mia Sara), is attacked, he must travel across time to rescue her and save the future.

programme.title: Safe Men
programme.desc: Sam (Sam Rockwell) and Eddie (Steve Zahn) are just a couple of clueless, untalented singers. But, when they are mistaken for a pair of safecracking geniuses by a mobster named Veal Chop (Paul Giamatti), they are unwittingly sucked into a life of crime. Though they have no idea what they are doing, Sam and Eddie have no choice but to go along with the Mafia's orders and break into three safes. Things get even more complicated when Sam falls for the daughter of one of their robbery victims.

programme.title: Hot Fuzz
programme.desc: As a former London constable, Nicholas Angel (Simon Pegg) finds it difficult to adapt to his new assignment in the sleepy British village of Sandford. Not only does he miss the excitement of the big city, but he also has a well-meaning oaf (Nick Frost) for a partner. However, when a series of grisly accidents rocks Sandford, Nick smells something rotten in the idyllic village.

programme.title: Kicking & Screaming
programme.desc: As a child, Phil Weston (Will Ferrell) was never able to live up to the demands of his overbearing father, Buck (Robert Duvall), who wanted Phil to be an athlete. Now a parent himself, Phil has inherited his father's competitive nature, while his son, Sam (Dylan McLaughlin), has inherited Phil's lack of athletic talent. Serving as Sam's soccer coach, Phil hopes to turn his last-place team of losers into champions, so they can beat the rival team coached by Buck.

programme.title: The Boss
programme.desc: Wealthy CEO Michelle Darnell (Melissa McCarthy) always gets her way, until she's busted for insider trading and sent to federal prison. After leaving jail, Darnell finds herself broke, homeless and hated. Luckily, she tracks down former assistant Claire (Kristen Bell), the only person who's willing to help. While staying with Claire and her young daughter, the ex-con devises a new business model for a brownie empire. Unfortunately, some old enemies stand in the way of her return to the top.

programme.title: Bulletproof
programme.desc: A none-too-bright criminal, Archie Moses (Adam Sandler) works for drug kingpin Frank Colton (James Caan) and remains oblivious to the fact that one of his closest buddies is actually an undercover police officer named Jack Carter (Damon Wayans). After Moses accidentally shoots Carter, the cop must recover and then bring the two-bit thug in to take the stand against Colton. With Carter and Moses on far from good terms, however, the trip does not go well.

programme.title: Best Little Whorehouse in Texas
programme.desc: Miss Mona (Dolly Parton) runs the Chicken Ranch, a brothel with a long history in a small Texas town. The locals have a good relationship with the institution, and Mona is respected in the community. The sheriff, Ed Earl Dodd (Burt Reynolds), also looks out for the Chicken Ranch due to his past with Miss Mona. However, when pious reporter Melvin Thorpe (Dom DeLuise) exposes the brothel, outside interests want it shut down, putting the governor (Charles Durning) in a tough spot.

programme.title: Junior
programme.desc: A research scientist becomes the world's first pregnant man in order to test a drug he and a colleague have designed for expectant women. To carry out the trial, he has an embryo implant, believing that he will only carry the baby for three months - hardly expecting to face the prospect of giving birth.

programme.title: Midnight Run
programme.desc: When Eddie Moscone (Joe Pantoliano) hires tight-lipped bounty hunter Jack Walsh (Robert De Niro) to locate a mob accountant named "The Duke" (Charles Grodin) and bring him to L.A., Eddie tells Jack that the job will be simple, or a "midnight run." But when Jack finds The Duke, the FBI and the mob are anxious to get their hands on him. In a cross-country chase, Jack must evade the authorities, hide from the mob and prevent The Duke's erratic personality from driving him mad.

programme.title: Playing for Keeps
programme.desc: Danny (Danny Jordano), Spikes (Matthew Penn) and Silk (Leon W. Grant) have just finished high school in New York City and are wondering what their next step will be. Danny receives the title to a big house in a rural community and gets the idea to refurbish it, turning it into a rock 'n' roll hotel. With some aid from investors, they're on their way. However, they soon face vehement opposition from locals, who resent the outsiders, and local politicians, who want to use the site as a dump.

But when Braxton's latest attempt at going straight becomes a frustrating series of mishaps, he struggles to complete the job he was hired to do while resisting his growing affection for Vivian and the children.

programme.title: Brewster's Millions
programme.desc: After losing his position as a minor-league pitcher, Montgomery Brewster (Richard Pryor) learns his great-uncle has left him $300 million. To inherit it, Brewster must spend $30 million in 30 days under a complicated set of rules that forbid him from donating too much to charity or retaining any new assets when the period is up. Unable to share details about the will's odd conditions with anyone, Brewster sets out to spend his money under the stern eye of paralegal Angela Drake (Lonette McKee).

programme.title: The Four Seasons
programme.desc: Jack (Alan Alda) and Kate (Carol Burnett) traditionally go on vacation with their friends every new season. Old friend Nick (Len Cariou) surprises everyone when he arrives not with his wife, Anne (Sandy Dennis), but with his new girlfriend, the much younger Ginny (Bess Armstrong). The group -- all of which had grown to be good friends with Anne -- must come to terms with this unexpected development. Ultimately, they learn to accept Nick's decision, and work to welcome Ginny as a friend.

programme.title: The Best of Times
programme.desc: Married banker Jack Dundee (Robin Williams) has lived his life regretting a botched play he made in a high school football game. His friend Reno Hightower (Kurt Russell), who threw the pass that Jack dropped, is deeply in debt from operating his car garage. With Reno, Jack hatches a plan to reunite all the players from the old game and replay it, hoping that this time he can make amends. When the game eventually happens, Jack again finds himself at the center of a key play.
